images.title: 104 squared in four tiles
images.purpose: Shows the square of sum tiles for 104 = 100 + 4: one big square, two thin strips and a small square.
images.composition: One large square centred, split into four tiles. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A square with side split into 100 and 4 (the 4 part drawn as a narrow band). Top left large teal (#0072B2) square labelled '10000'; top right thin amber (#E69F00) strip labelled '400'; bottom left thin amber strip labelled '400'; bottom right small reddish purple (#CC79A7) square labelled '16'. Along the top edge, '100' over the large part and '4' over the narrow part. Centred below the square, the label '104² = 10816'. Exactly 4 tiles.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
